lines.trans: Max, we urgently need to clarify something.
Guys, I really do not have time for you now.
What did you tell Nastya about me?
I was just joking a little, do not be mad.
Joking? You called me a real psycho!
I wanted to protect you from mistakes.
First you promised to help, and then bailed!
I did not want to hurt you, Kostya.
Because of your stupid words Nastya left.
Forgive me, I will fix everything today.
Never poke your nose into my business again!
Kostya, wait, let us discuss everything calmly.
Some best friend you are, leave!

examples.trans: We need to do even more.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: + infinitive: давай убирать = let's clean up

related.gloss: to give (the verb it comes from)

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

злиться.gloss: to be angry, to get mad

meanings.en: to be angry, to get mad

examples.text: А знаешь, почему ты так злишься?
examples.trans: And do you know why you are so angry?
Don't be angry with me, please.

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!
We were late because of the rain.

meanings.en: to fix, to correct, to put right

examples.trans: Excuse us, we will fix everything.

examples.text: Ученик быстро исправил ошибку в тетради.
examples.trans: The pupil quickly corrected the mistake in his notebook.

кинуть.gloss: to throw, to toss, to fling

meanings.en: to throw, to toss, to hurl

examples.trans: We'll throw a bottle through her window.
The boy threw the ball to the dog.
I want to show you something.

лезть.gloss: to climb; to push in, to barge in

meanings.note: лезть на дерево = to climb a tree

meanings.en: to push in, to barge in
meanings.note: лезть без очереди = to jump the queue; лезть вперёд кого-то = to push in ahead of someone
colloquial: не лезь! = keep out of it!

examples.trans: The cat is climbing the tree.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world

examples.trans: You called me a real psycho!

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

наговорить.gloss: to say a lot of (too much)

meanings.en: to say a lot of, blurt out too much
meanings.note: + genitive: наговорить лишнего = to say too much

examples.trans: Yesterday I said too much to you.
He said a lot of foolish things.

meanings.note: кого + instrumental: назвать меня плохим словом

examples.trans: You called me a bad word.
What will you name your son?

meanings.note: of things, places, films: 'как называется ...?' = what is ... called?

examples.trans: The operation is called Golden Yard.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

meanings.en: to offend, to hurt someone's feelings

examples.trans: Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.
He didn't want to offend anyone.

examples.text: Без лишних ушей обсудим твоё назначение.
examples.trans: Without extra ears we will discuss your appointment.
The partners discussed the terms of the deal in detail.
This is some kind of mistake!

examples.text: Он сегодня пообещал построить нам новое здание.
examples.trans: Today he promised to build us a new building.

пошутить.gloss: to joke, to make a joke

meanings.note: я пошутил(а) = I was only joking

examples.text: Я смотрю, вы легковерный! Я же пошутила!
examples.trans: I see you're gullible! I was only joking!
Don't be offended, I was only joking.

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.
We urgently need to clarify something.

meanings.note: informal: a group of young men; ребята! = guys!

examples.trans: The boys will have a word with you.

meanings.note: 'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word

examples.trans: First they were rude and insulting over there.
Let's start everything from the beginning.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.text: Я хотел уберечь тебя от ошибок.
examples.trans: I wanted to protect you from mistakes.

уйти.gloss: to leave, to go away (on foot)

meanings.en: to leave, to go away, to walk out
to leave, to go away (on foot)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
